facts.fact: The Mauritius Standards Bureau runs a National Information Security Management System Certification Scheme against MS ISO/IEC 27001:2022, an information security standard it treats as a national standard.
facts.system: MS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 under the MSB National ISMS Certification Scheme

facts.fact: The register lists 11 certified organisations as at 30 June 2026, including the Passport and Immigration Office (certificate issued 30 October 2025), CERT-Mu, the Mauritius Revenue Authority, the Police IT Unit and the National Sanctions Secretariat, with accredited certificates.
facts.system: MS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 under the MSB National ISMS Certification Scheme
